status: frozen model inference before scenario evaluation; not accepted
interpretation: Crop-potential archetypes do not establish historical agricultural management where both related cropland reconstructions and dated irrigation are zero. Use explicit livelihood management uncertainty instead; named historical systems override this fallback.
source_family: HYDE and LUH2 related land reconstructions; not independent evidence of absence
numerical_basis: Shared ordinal game-management scale. Pastoral estimates retain field/feed maintenance, cultivation and coordination; foraging estimate retains coordination. These are inferred scenario bounds, not measured historical D. Hectares select applicability only and never scale D.
exclusions: No population, population density, fitted capacity or survival target in rule
No automatic inference from missing land values
Zero reconstructed cropland is not proof of no cultivation; preserve inferred status and named overrides
No added land, water, food production or consumption changes
